component.name: ListBox
component.description: Renders a flat semantic list with optional filtering and selection behavior.

slots.name: itemWrapper
slots.description: Wrapper around the label and description.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary item content displayed below the label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the item cannot be highlighted or selected.

props.name: keywords
props.description: Additional terms included by the default filter.

props.name: leadingRender
props.description: Renders content before the item label.

props.name: trailingRender
props.description: Renders content after the item label and description.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value used for selection, highlighting, and element identity.

own.name: ariaLabel
own.description: Accessible name for the interactive listbox element.

own.name: ariaLabelledby
own.description: IDs of elements that label the interactive listbox element.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: Initial selected value or values for uncontrolled usage.

own.name: emptyRender
own.description: Renders the empty state when no item entries remain.

own.name: getItemSearchText
own.description: Returns searchable text when labels are not plain strings.

own.name: id
own.description: Root element ID used to derive option IDs.

own.name: itemProps
own.description: Returns additional attributes for an item row.

own.name: itemRender
own.description: Replaces the default contents of every item row.

own.name: items
own.description: Items and structural rows to display.

own.name: onSelect
own.description: Called after an item is selected or toggled.

own.name: scrollToItem
own.description: Called when keyboard navigation highlights an item.

own.name: searchValue
own.description: External search text used to filter item entries.

own.name: virtualRender
own.description: Renders filtered entries through a caller-provided virtualization layer.
